# Variable `QB_SMP`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

When using `runqemu`, the QB_SMP variable controls amount of CPU cores made available inside the QEMU guest, each mapped to a thread on the host.

For example:

```
QB_SMP = "-smp 8"

```

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-QB_SMP)
